You know the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplProduceFla]{Produce Flame} cantrip. Starting at character level 3, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplBurningHan]{Burning Hands} with this trait, and starting at character level 5, you can also cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFlameBlade]{Flame Blade} with it, without a Material component. Once you cast either spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell this way again until you finish a Long Rest; you can also cast either of them with any spell slots of the appropriate level you have. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you select this species).

Foundry Note

Choose the same spellcasting ability for the spells of levels 3 and 5.
